Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about TaskFlow and our services.

You can sign up for TaskFlow for free, with no credit card required. You will have full access to all Pro features for 14 days. After the trial ends, you can choose a plan or continue with our free tier.

Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time from your account settings. If you upgrade, the change will be immediate. If you downgrade, it will take effect at the end of your current billing cycle.

Absolutely. We use enterprise-grade encryption (AES-256) for all data at rest and TLS 1.3 for data in transit. We also perform regular security audits and are SOC2 Type II compliant.

Yes! We love supporting organizations that make a difference. Contact our support team with proof of your non-profit status, and we will apply a 50% discount to your account.

We will notify you when you reach 80% and 90% of your storage limit. If you exceed it, you will still be able to access your data, but you won't be able to upload new files until you upgrade or free up space.
